chunks: And by this chain of narration, from Ibn Abbas, regarding His saying: <q>Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its death</q>

It means He will restore the earth through the Qa'im (Riser) of the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) after its death. Meaning after the tyranny/corruption of the people of its kingdom. <q>Indeed, We have clarified the verses for you</q> refers to the Qa'im of the Family of Muhammad, <q>so that you may understand</q>.

key_terms.قائم: The Riser/Exalter, a title for Imam Mahdi (AS)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic verse 'Allah gives life to the earth after its death' mean in Shia interpretation?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Ibn Abbas interprets the Quranic phrase 'giving life to the earth after its death' as a reference to the era of the Qa'im from the Ahl al-Bayt, contrasting it with the preceding period of 'jaur' (tyranny) under previous rulers. This exegesis highlights the Mahdi’s role not merely as a political leader but as the divine agent who restores spiritual and cosmic order, fulfilling the promise that Allah has made clear through signs for those who reflect.
